ios.desc:
Your companion for EV road trips. See where your battery runs low along the route, pick the charging stops you prefer, and let Ranger Pro find the next charger on your network — right in CarPlay.

PLAN THE TRIP

•   See your range on the map
Your route is colored by the battery you'll have left — green when it's high, red when it's low, black where you'd run out.

•   Choose your own stops
Browse charging stations along the route and add the ones you like. Ranger shows your battery on arrival and after charging, and how long the stop takes.

•   Tune it to your car
Set your starting charge and consumption with simple sliders and watch the route update instantly.

•   Arrive with a buffer
Plan to arrive with charge to spare, not a warning light.

ON THE ROAD WITH RANGER PRO

•   Find the next charger
See the chargers ahead on your route, with the distance, your arrival time and the battery you'll have when you get there. Pick one and make it your next stop.

•   Filter by network
On a charging plan with Electrify America or another network? Show only their chargers, so every stop is at the rates you pay.

•   In CarPlay
The list follows you onto the car's screen and updates as you drive. One glance tells you whether the next charger is still within reach — or whether it's time to stop sooner.

•   Plan while you charge
Waiting at a charger? Adjust the rest of the trip, line up your next stops, and see how much charge you need to get there.

YOUR TRIP, YOUR CALL

Ranger doesn't pick stops for you. It shows you the whole picture — range, chargers and arrival charge — so you decide where to stop, based on how you drive and where you're going.

quotes.text:
I just released my app Ranger – EV Route Planner.

Most route planners pick charging stops that don’t really suit me – too few chargers, bad food options, not enough margin, wrong networks, you name it. I often want to choose myself.

Ranger shows a simple, color-coded line, so you can easily see your estimated battery level along your route. It also highlights charging locations based on how many chargers there are – so you can avoid lonely two-stall stations.

It's available for iOS and it's completely free. Check it out!
